text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: “—Aaaand that's all from Smart Falcon☆ Thanks for watching the concert~♪”

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fans
text_block_list.text: "Falco~! That was awesome~!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all for gathering here!
See you on the next stage♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Having achieved results in races, Smart Falcon's
popularity was steadily rising, and more spectators
began stopping by to watch her street performances."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yup♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
With so many people cheering me on,
Falco is one lucky girl!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: The best way to repay everyone who became my fan is to become the top Umadol, right!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
There'll be more races I can run this year,
and I want to appear on lots of stages to meet everyone.
choice_data_list: We gotta decide on our next target race too.
We need to decide on our next target race too, don't we?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...!
The next goal...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon is steadily growing.
Even if she challenges major Classic-tier races, she should be able to secure convincing victories.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...You see,
about that—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—What Smart Falcon had to say
was quite unexpected.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Falco wants to run in the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The first race of the Classic Triple Crown, the Satsuki Sho.
It is indeed a massive race, but—
choice_data_list: It's a turf race, you know

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. Turf races, where Falco
always ends up doing terribly..."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Still, I really want to take on the challenge...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her serious gaze reminded me of when we first met.
She was obsessed with turf and desperately wanted to succeed on it.
I thought she had moved past that, but...
choice_data_list: Do you still have lingering feelings for turf?
Do you still have lingering feelings for turf?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"No, that's not it!
I don't have any regrets at all!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"I've already made up my mind to keep running on the dirt.
But, but you see..."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Do you remember that fan the other day
mentioning they wanted to hear
'winning the soul'?"

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fan B
text_block_list.text: "Still, wouldn't you have wanted to hear a girl who puts her all into it like that sing 'winning the soul'?"

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I really would've loved to hear it.
On that super hyped-up Classic stage, you know?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
“But you can only sing 『winning the soul』
if you're in the Classic class
and on the Triple Crown path.”

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "If you don't take on the challenge here, no one's ever going to hear you out."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"I don't want that. Falco wants to be
an Umadol who lives up to everyone's expectations!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Not so long ago, I only had a handful of fans you could count on one hand.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, so many people
had started cheering for me...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone has high hopes for Falco.
I really wanna do my best..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She has pursued her activities with few fans by her side.
That is likely why her feelings toward those who do support her are so uniquely strong. However...
choice_data_list: Winning is going to be pretty tough.
Winning is going to be pretty tough, you know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Not only is turf already a terrible matchup for her,
her opponents are top-class Umamusume aiming for the Triple Crown.
It's doubtful whether she can even put up a proper fight."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "...I know. It's been impossible all along, after all..."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Still! Refusing to even try
is not the way of an Umadol!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
If someone believes in me
and wants to hear Falco's songs, then...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Inside that 0% chance,
I want to bet on that tiny, tiny 1%!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Always going out to seize that brilliance.
That's the kind of Umadol Falco believes in!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's why, Trainer...!
Please let Falco run in the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For her fans, and for her convictions. She was about to run down a grueling path. If so, as her Trainer—there was only one answer.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
choice_data_list: Let's take on the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Wooww...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her sheer enthusiasm helped me make up my mind.
Our next target race...
is the Classic race, the Satsuki Sho!
